name: Lynas Rare Earths Limited
content: Lynas Rare Earths Limited is the world’s only significant producer of separated rare earth materials outside of China. The company operates the high-grade Mt Weld mine and concentration plant in Western Australia and a major refining facility in Kuantan, Malaysia. Lynas specializes in the extraction and processing of rare earth minerals, primarily Neodymium and Praseodymium (NdPr), which are essential components for high-strength permanent magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, and advanced electronics. As a key player in the global critical minerals supply chain, Lynas is expanding its industrial footprint with a new processing facility in Kalgoorlie and planned operations in the United States.

Officers

Amanda Lacaze(Date: 2014 June)

Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

Amanda Lacaze was appointed as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Lynas on 25 June 2014. She has over 35 years of experience in senior operational roles including as CEO of Commander Communications, Executive Chairman of Orion Telecommunications and CEO of AOL|7. Amanda is a Non-Executive Director of the Minerals Council of Australia and a member of the Australian Government’s First Nations Clean Energy Strategy Advisory Group.

Gaudenz Sturzenegger(Date: 2018 January)

Chief Financial Officer

Gaudenz Sturzenegger joined Lynas in 2011 and was appointed Chief Financial Officer in 2018. He has extensive experience in financial management, corporate finance, and accounting within the resources sector.

Pol Le Roux(Date: 2022 January)

Chief Operating Officer

Pol Le Roux joined Lynas in 2010 and is the Chief Operating Officer. He has over 30 years of experience in the rare earths industry, including senior roles in sales, marketing, and operations.

Sarah Leonard(Date: 2021 January)

General Counsel and Company Secretary

Sarah Leonard is the General Counsel and Company Secretary. She joined Lynas in 2021 and has extensive experience in corporate law and governance.

Directors

John Humphrey(Date: 2023 November)

Chairman

John Humphrey was appointed as a Non-Executive Director on 15 May 2017 and as Chairman on 30 November 2023. He is a former Executive Dean of the Faculty of Law at Queensland University of Technology and a former Senior Partner of King & Wood Mallesons.

Amanda Lacaze(Date: 2014 June)

Managing Director

Managing Director and CEO. See executive profile for details.

Vanessa Guthrie(Date: 2020 October)

Non-Executive Director

Dr. Vanessa Guthrie was appointed as a Non-Executive Director on 1 October 2020. She has over 30 years of experience in the mining and energy sectors and is a former CEO of Toro Energy Limited.

Grant Murdoch(Date: 2017 October)

Non-Executive Director

Grant Murdoch was appointed as a Non-Executive Director on 30 October 2017. He is a Chartered Accountant and was previously a partner of Ernst & Young and Deloitte.

John Beevers(Date: 2023 May)

Non-Executive Director

John Beevers was appointed as a Non-Executive Director on 1 May 2023. He has over 30 years of experience in the resources and chemical industries, including as CEO of Orica Mining Services.
